title: Gold Bar XL Banana Ice Prefilled Pod + Refill
description: The Gold Bar XL Refill Kit in Banana Ice delivers the smooth taste of ripe Banana with a refreshing Menthol twist. Each pack includes a 2ml prefilled pod and an attached 10ml refill reservoir, filled with 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid. Together, they extend your vaping time with consistent flavour and a satisfying mouth-to-lung (MTL) experience. Designed for the Gold Bar XL Prefilled Pod Kit, this refill combo offers convenience and great flavour without the need to refill manually. The built-in mesh coil inside the pod enhances flavour clarity and vapour output, while the closed format makes swapping flavours quick and mess-free.
